model_card.summary: Final frozen teacher baselines and width/loss/packed student comparisons.
model_card.scope: Compare frozen attribute-SFT, style and MoE story teachers with fresh one-layer dense students trained by gold CE, actual teacher-hard answers or CE+KL, and their packed4 variants, on the original held-out families.
limitations: GSM8K diagnostic uses only complete prompts fitting the tiny context; tiny selected denominator, not a full benchmark
teacher agreement is reported separately from gold answer accuracy
teacher errors and regressions remain in saved reports
Teacher agreement, held-out gold accuracy and storage/timing are distinct outcomes. This small run cannot establish universal compression gains.

Reported file-byte counts measure the experiment's source inference artifacts. The public exporter removes RNG/training metadata, so published file sizes can differ; tensor-byte counts describe the stored model tensors. Packed low-bit checkpoints are reference inference formats and do not support training resume.
GSM8K complete context-fitting questions occur only in the selected out-of-domain error audit and are not a training source for these selected students. Raw teacher logits/target caches are omitted.

The eleven trained students initialize fresh one-layer models; SFT, style and MoE teachers are separate frozen sources, with per-file roles and budgets in checkpoint_training. No real_text checkpoint is loaded. CE+KL uses alpha=0.5 and T=2 on aligned gold-prefix target positions, applying T² once.

The attribute teacher's actual 45/45 training outputs exactly equal gold answer IDs plus EOS. Consequently CE and teacher-hard branches have identical targets and final parameter hashes at each width; they do not provide distinct supervision in this branch. Teacher test is 5/10; width16 students are 1/10, width32 CE/hard/KL are 4/10 and packed width32 KL is 3/10.

The style teacher has 180/185 correct hard training targets and five wrong ones. On held-out data, teacher and all style students have zero correct arithmetic answers across 21 style-labelled rows despite 7/7 valid JSON formats; their 3/27 overall content matches come from clarification, not arithmetic competence.

MoE-to-dense students use only the first 32 of 409 original training documents (213 chunks), with 300 updates and 559651 supervised targets; there is no teacher-hard branch. Teacher and students all score the full 52 held-out documents. Test NLL is teacher 2.3017035253733837, CE 2.460136601788036, CE+KL 2.388968066028803 and packed KL 2.4057227158959416; all have zero exact fixed-reference continuations and zero EOS completions.

The GSM8K audit selects only original rows 14 and 94: two complete prompts fit the 128-token context with 24 reserved generation tokens, while 198 do not. Teacher and every evaluated SFT student have 0/2 correct answers. This is neither a training source nor a full GSM8K benchmark.

sft-w32-ce_kl.pt is the predeclared primary student, not selected for best test NLL or general ability. Lower teacher agreement, gold accuracy and content/style correctness remain separately reported.
